title: Nightly Platform Review
description: Reads this platform's telemetry and agent conversations once a night and PROPOSES changes as pull requests. Applies nothing. Ships inert: dryRun true and an empty proposalAllowlist. REQUIRED BY core-provider, which derives the Composition CRD from this file.

global.title: Global values (injected by the Krateo composition engine)

proposalAllowlist.title: Where each proposal kind may open a pull request
proposalAllowlist.description: EMPTY MEANS DENY ALL, and a kind absent from this map is denied too. target.repo is model-chosen from a corpus containing user chat text; without this list a sentence in a conversation could aim the write credential anywhere. A proposal naming a repo outside its kind's list is refused, never redirected. A kind may permit SEVERAL repositories: this is a boundary, not a routing table, and the agent chooses among them from the evidence it holds. Prefer the mapping form — the descriptions are passed to the model so it can choose the right home rather than the first one.

oneOf.title: Permitted repositories mapped to what each one is for

clickhouseQueries.title: Evidence queries
clickhouseQueries.description: Named SQL as configuration rather than code, so it is reviewable and adaptable without a new image. {from}/{to} are substituted; nothing else is.
